guide.summary: A pretend chemical that bothers only three kinds of bacteria.
guide.biology: Some microbes release substances that hold back competing neighbours; this made-up extract stands in for that broad idea.
guide.rules: Adds RIVAL activity that spreads at half the normal rate and loses 2 % per second. It targets only B01 Sprinter, B10 Brinecoil and B11 Sourbud, adding 0.25 times the local RIVAL to their inhibitor exposure, halved once in a cell with biofilm; growth is multiplied by 1 / (1 + exposure) and health falls by 8 times the exposure each second. Everything else is unaffected. It is the same field Rampart releases. No additional modeled reaction. This is an abstract game mechanic, not a claim about how any real product works.
guide.example: Add rivalry extract where Sprinters and Crumbsmiths share sugar and see how the balance shifts.
